title: E0029: Class Fan-in and Fan-out
plain_english: Reports classes whose fan-out or fan-in exceeds configured thresholds.
why_matters: - **High fan-out** means a class depends on many other classes, making it more fragile and harder to change. - **High fan-in** means many classes depend on this class, so changes can have wide impact and require careful testing.
what_it_checks: **Fan-out**: number of distinct classes a class depends on.
**Fan-in**: number of other classes that depend on this class.
Dependencies are collected from type hints, `new` instantiations, `instanceof` checks, static method calls, and property/constant access.
